variant_desc: ml-dsa crate: pkDecode (split_vk + decode_t1) and sigDecode (decode_z, Hint::bit_unpack with FIPS validity rules, ||z|| bound).
Word-wise unpacking: 5 bytes -> 4 t1 coefficients, 9/5 bytes -> 4/2 z coefficients via u64 windows, direct hint index scan; no generic bit cursor.
The k + l polynomial unpackings of v1 spread over a 4-thread rayon pool (hint scan serial).
ml-dsa crate: tr = H(pk, 64) and mu = H(tr || 0 || |ctx| || ctx || M, 64) through its ShakeState/MuBuilder.
tr cached per public key (as a cached VerifyingKey holds it): only the mu SHAKE-256 is computed.
sha3 crate's Shake256 used directly with finalize_xof_into (no sponge clone, no XofReader object).
ml-dsa crate expand_a: k*l sequential SHAKE-128 rejection samplings (840-byte initial squeeze, 3 bytes at a time afterwards).
Four matrix entries sampled at once: 4-lane AVX2 Keccak-f[1600] (one __m256i per state word), same 3-byte stream parser; scalar lanes without AVX2.
Rows of A sampled in parallel on a 4-thread rayon pool (crate rej_ntt_poly per entry).
A^ cached per public key (the crate's VerifyingKey keeps it): the stage is the clone of the cached matrix.
Scalar raw SHAKE-128 on the keccak permutation (no digest buffering/state cloning) with the streaming 3-byte parser.
ml-dsa crate algebra: SampleInBall, NTT(z), NTT(c), NTT(t1*2^d), A^ o z^ - c^ o t1^, NTT^-1 (u128 Barrett products, ct ops).
Reference-style i32 Montgomery arithmetic: lazy i64 accumulation of the l row products, one Montgomery reduction per coefficient, invntt with 2^32-scaled zetas, caddq.
NTT(t1 * 2^d) precomputed for the key (as the crate's VerifyingKey does); crate algebra otherwise.
Rows of w' (l products + accumulate + inverse NTT each) computed in parallel on a 4-thread rayon pool.
Lazy reduction: the l products of a row accumulated in u64 and reduced once per coefficient; crate NTTs.
ml-dsa crate: ||z|| bound, Hint::use_hint (ct_select, two modulo ops per coefficient), encode_w1, H(mu || w1Encode) compared with c~.
Non-constant-time Decompose/UseHint (native division by the public 2*gamma2, branches) with a direct 4/6-bit w1 packer; crate SHAKE.
HighBits for all coefficients, hint applied only at the <= omega hinted positions, final SHAKE-256 on the raw keccak permutation.
End-to-end verify chained from the v0 stage implementations.
decode.v1 fastunpack + mu.v2 direct-sha3 + expandA.v1 x4-keccak (v4 fastparse without AVX2) + w_approx.v1 montgomery + hint_check.v2 sparse-rawshake
slh-dsa crate: Signature::try_from (full parse into nested arrays), P::h_msg (SHAKE256 or SHA-2 + MGF1), split_digest.
Zero-copy signature parse (length check + borrowed R/FORS/HT slices) with the crate's h_msg.
Zero-copy parse + raw H_msg: SHAKE256 on the permutation, or SHA-2 on the compression function with the MGF1 seed prefix hashed once as a midstate.
slh-dsa crate fors_pk_from_sig (digest-API F/H with a cloned pk_seed-prefixed hasher per call, T over the k roots).
Fused raw hashing: one padded block on keccak-f / SHA-2 compress with a PK.seed midstate, borrowed signature slices, byte-array addresses.
The k FORS trees walked four at a time in lockstep on the 4-lane AVX2 Keccak (SHA2 sets: scalar raw path).
The k trees in parallel on a 4-thread rayon pool (crate hash functions).
slh-dsa crate wots_pk_from_sig for each of the d layers (base_2b digits, chain of F calls, T over the len chain ends).
Fused raw hashing (single-block keccak-f / SHA-256 midstate per F), borrowed slices, byte-array addresses.
All d*len chains flattened and advanced four at a time in lockstep on the 4-lane Keccak; finished lanes hash a dummy (SHA2 sets: scalar raw path).
The d layers in parallel on a 4-thread rayon pool (crate wots_pk_from_sig).
The auth-path loop of the crate's xmss_pk_from_sig for each layer (crate H with its HashTree address) + compare with PK.root.
Fused raw hashing on borrowed auth-path slices (single-block keccak-f / SHA-512 or SHA-256 midstate per H).
The d layers' auth paths climbed four at a time in lockstep on the 4-lane Keccak (SHA2 sets: scalar raw path).
The d layers in parallel on a 4-thread rayon pool (crate H).
End-to-end verify chained from the v0 stage implementations.
hmsg.v2 raw-hmsg + fors.v2 x4-keccak + ht_wots.v2 x4-chains + ht_auth.v1 raw (SHA2 sets: scalar raw fused hashing)
